maya.trigger_word: East Asian woman in her late 20s, short straight black hair with subtle blue highlights, round wire-frame glasses, wearing an oversized dark purple hoodie with a small robot logo, dark jeans, white sneakers, confident posture but tired eyes, warm skin tone

derek.trigger_word: Tall Black man in his early 30s, immaculately trimmed short beard, confident smile, wearing a fitted navy blazer over a bright graphic tee with geometric patterns, slim khaki chinos, clean white leather shoes, silver watch

priya.trigger_word: South Asian woman in her mid 20s, long dark wavy hair often in a loose side braid, warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a white blouse, colorful printed scarf, high-waisted olive green pants, brown ankle boots, always carrying a leather-bound sketchbook

finn.trigger_word: Pale Irish man in his late 20s, messy curly red hair, light freckles across his nose, perpetually confused wide-eyed expression, wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt with palm trees over a plain white t-shirt, cargo shorts, worn sandals

living_room.trigger_word: Modern San Francisco apartment living room with a panoramic window showing the Bay Bridge at golden hour, cluttered with tech gadgets, a large whiteboard covered in diagrams, mismatched furniture including a worn leather couch and beanbag chairs, tangled cables, a broken espresso machine on a side table, warm ambient lighting

kitchen.trigger_word: Small galley kitchen in a San Francisco apartment, cluttered countertops with smart home gadgets, a tablet mounted on the fridge showing notifications, coffee mugs with tech company logos, morning light streaming through a small window, cozy and lived-in

maya_desk.trigger_word: Corner desk setup in a San Francisco apartment, three monitors showing code and terminal windows, mechanical keyboard with custom keycaps, desk lamp casting warm light, energy drink cans, sticky notes everywhere, a small succulent plant, late night atmosphere

hallway.trigger_word: Narrow apartment hallway with coats hanging on hooks, shoes piled by the door, a smart doorbell with a blinking red light, package boxes stacked against the wall, overhead fluorescent light

rooftop.trigger_word: San Francisco apartment building rooftop at dusk, panoramic city skyline view with fog rolling in, string lights hung between posts, a couple of folding chairs and a small table, the Bay Bridge glowing in the background, cinematic golden hour lighting

shots.camera_angle: close-up on face, monitor glow illuminating features, slow zoom in
shots.action_start: Maya stares at her monitor in disbelief, her face lit by the blue glow of cascading error logs, mouth slightly open in shock
shots.action_end: Maya slowly removes her glasses and rubs her tired eyes, then puts them back on — the errors are still there

shots.camera_angle: medium shot from side, showing Maya and the three monitors
shots.action_start: Maya slumps back in her chair, defeated, head tilted toward the ceiling, arms limp at her sides
shots.action_end: Maya sits up straight with renewed determination, jaw set, eyes locked on the screen — she reaches for an empty energy drink can, finds it empty, tosses it aside

shots.camera_angle: over-the-shoulder shot from behind monitors, phone in hand
shots.action_start: Maya grabs her phone from the desk, scrolling through contacts with urgency, her face illuminated by the phone screen
shots.action_end: Maya holds the phone to her ear, waiting for an answer, free hand gripping the edge of the desk — tension in her knuckles

shots.camera_angle: medium wide shot, eye level, capturing Derek at counter and Priya at table
shots.action_start: Derek stands at the kitchen counter in his blazer, scrolling through his phone with one hand and pouring coffee with the other — missing the mug entirely, coffee pooling on the counter
shots.action_end: Priya glances up from her sketchbook with mild annoyance, one eyebrow raised, as Derek enthusiastically waves his phone showing his PetCoin logo

shots.camera_angle: tracking shot following Finn as he enters, then cutting between the three characters
shots.action_start: Finn bursts through the kitchen doorway in his Hawaiian shirt, eyes wide and alarmed, clutching his phone like evidence at a crime scene
shots.action_end: Finn stands in the center of the kitchen, arms spread in exasperation as Derek grins and Priya deadpans about the coffee maker and toaster being in love

shots.camera_angle: two-shot of Finn calling after Priya, Derek laughing in background
shots.action_start: Priya stands up from the table, tucking her sketchbook under her arm, shaking her head with a resigned smirk as she heads for the door
shots.action_end: Finn calls after her about the smart lock logging bathroom breaks, while Derek leans against the counter, phone raised, still grinning about blockchain

shots.camera_angle: wide establishing shot of the living room, then quick pan to Maya at the door
shots.action_start: Maya bursts through the living room entrance, laptop clutched under her arm, hair disheveled from hours at the desk, eyes wild with urgency
shots.action_end: The room freezes — Finn crouching by a smart plug with a magnifying glass looks up, Derek mid-pitch on the couch with an imaginary audience turns — all eyes on Maya

shots.camera_angle: over-the-shoulder alternating between Maya and Finn, with Derek visible on couch
shots.action_start: Finn pulls out his laptop and begins typing rapidly, his bewildered expression sharpening into focus as code scrolls across the screen
shots.action_end: Finn looks up from the screen and points at Maya — the git blame reveals it was her code, three weeks ago at 2:14 AM — Maya buries her face in her hands

shots.camera_angle: medium shot of Derek on the couch, Maya and Finn visible in foreground
shots.action_start: Derek leans back on the couch, adjusting his blazer with a self-satisfied grin, arms spread wide as if delivering a TED talk
shots.action_end: Derek delivers his punchline about never writing code with a cheerful shrug, while Maya lifts her head from her hands to glare at him

shots.camera_angle: wide shot showing both characters hunched at the desk, monitors glowing red with failing tests
shots.action_start: Maya and Finn sit side by side at the desk, both hunched forward, illuminated by the harsh glow of multiple monitors showing cascading red test failures
shots.action_end: Finn points at a specific line on screen while Maya types furiously, empty energy drink cans accumulating like a small fortress around their keyboards

shots.camera_angle: push in to close-up on Finn's face, then Maya's reaction
shots.action_start: Finn reads the damage report from the screen with clinical precision — undefined table, broken search, labrador profile photo — his expression shifting from analytical to amused
shots.action_end: Maya leans back in her chair, laughing despite herself at the labrador's 4.8-star rating, then quickly composes her face back to determined focus

shots.camera_angle: two-shot, medium close, both visible with monitors in background
shots.action_start: Maya checks the time on her phone and sits up straight with steel in her eyes — nine hours to fix fourteen tests
shots.action_end: Finn mentions the smart home devices having meetings at 3:12 AM with charts to prove it — Maya stares at him for a long beat, then deliberately turns back to her keyboard

shots.camera_angle: group shot, medium wide, all four roommates in frame, whiteboard behind Maya
shots.action_start: All four roommates are gathered in the living room in the late evening — Maya stands by the whiteboard covered in crossed-out diagrams, eyes bright with cautious hope
shots.action_end: Finn looks up from his laptop on the floor, suspicious — even test nine is passing — while Derek pumps his fist and credits his sage-burning for the success

shots.camera_angle: medium shots cutting between Derek with phone, Priya's skeptical face, and Finn on the floor
shots.action_start: Derek holds up his phone showing a dog-with-sunglasses logo, beaming with pride — Priya recoils in aesthetic disgust
shots.action_end: Finn calmly shows his phone — the smart fridge has autonomously ordered forty pounds of artisanal cheese using Derek's credit card — Derek's face cycles through confusion to horror

shots.camera_angle: close-up on Maya's finger hovering over the enter key, then pull back to include the group
shots.action_start: Priya smirks and delivers her blockchain jab — Derek sputters defensively — Maya cuts through the chaos with her finger poised over the enter key
shots.action_end: Maya counts down — three, two, one — finger presses enter, the room holds its breath, all four faces frozen in a mix of terror and anticipation

shots.camera_angle: close-up on monitor showing green deployment success, slow pull back to reveal Maya and Finn
shots.action_start: A monitor fills the frame displaying a green deployment success screen — the camera slowly pulls back to reveal Maya slumped in her chair, exhausted but smiling softly
shots.action_end: Finn sits beside her, equally spent, chin propped on his hand — the apartment is quiet save for the hum of monitors — Maya's eyes are half-closed with quiet satisfaction

shots.camera_angle: two-shot, intimate framing, warm desk lamp light
shots.action_start: Maya mumbles 'ship it' and her eyes drift shut — Finn looks at his phone with a mixture of concern and bewilderment
shots.action_end: Finn stares at his phone screen showing the smart doorbell's compliment to the delivery driver, then slowly looks up at the camera with a completely lost expression — the room falls silent
